name: Hollyland LARK M2 Wireless Dual Microphone System Type-C with Charging Case for Smartphone( copy )
description:
Main Features:

Ultra-clear sound quality with noise cancellation
USB-C receiver — plug & play, no app needed
Long battery life up to 10 hours
Stable 300m transmission range
Perfect for YouTube, TikTok, Facebook Live, and interviews
Compact charging case with stylish design
Package Includes:

2 × Transmitters (TX)
1 × Receiver (USB-C)
1 × Charging Case
1 × Cable & Accessories
This USB-C version is specially made for Android smartphones and Type-C compatible devices.
Experience crystal clear audio with the Hollyland LARK M2, the next-generation wireless lavalier microphone designed for vloggers, content creators, and mobile filmmakers.
Compatible With: Android phones, tablets, laptops with Type-C port
